description: This file contains UI components, theme definitions, and styling constants for a TV streaming platform's Android frontend, implemented using Jetpack Compose. It includes theme setup, color tokens, spacing, shape, elevation, typography, various composable UI elements like image banners, chips, icon buttons, poster cards, and utility functions for image loading and styling.

methods.name: StreamXTVTheme
methods.description: Sets a dark theme with specific color scheme and typography for the app.

methods.name: figmaImage
methods.description: Constructs a File object pointing to a Figma asset image based on a provided name or path.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Loads an image (SVG/PNG) from local assets using Coil's AsyncImage.

methods.name: HeroBanner
methods.description: Displays a large, cropped hero banner image. Uses AsyncImage with ContentScale.Crop.

methods.name: RowSection
methods.description: Creates a horizontal scrollable row with a title and a list of items rendered via a composable lambda.

methods.name: TagChip
methods.description: Displays a small rounded button-like label, e.g., for live tags.

methods.name: TvIconButton
methods.description: A circular button with an optional icon overlay, used for interactive icons.

methods.name: PosterCard
methods.description: A card displaying a poster image with optional progress bar, title, and trailing icons, designed for media content.

methods.name: Modifier.borderGlow
methods.description: Adds a border around a composable to simulate a glow effect for focus state.
